_README: VENDORED snapshot of the shared connection-type vocabulary (the stud sizes) from Data-Flow-Advisory/orchestrator @ feat/drift-gate, plus the new types this organ PROPOSES (marked `_proposed: true`). Conformance validates ports.json types against this file so the check is self-contained (no network in CI). The proposed types must be upstreamed into the canonical orchestrator types.json by the PR that lands this manifest — see PR body. Two organ ports connect iff their `type` matches. See CONNECTORS.md.

TenantContext.desc: A resolved tenant: identity, branding, provenance bag.

SiteCrawl.desc: Signals crawled from a prospect's website at signup.

InterviewTranscript.desc: Ordered Q&A pairs from a discovery interview.

KeyFacts.desc: Themed facts extracted from a transcript (the discovery memory).

EntityGraph.desc: Deduplicated canonical entities (people, systems, tools) per tenant.

Blueprint.desc: The system blueprint: modules + integrations + current/recommended state.

ProcessFlow.desc: Sequence / swimlane of a workflow extracted from transcript themes.

AccountState.desc: A fleet account's pacing/quota state (the pace + drift gates' input).

ClaimVerdict.desc: Whether a worker may claim work now, and why (gate output).

BillingState.desc: A tenant's subscription / billing state + feature entitlements.

ConformanceVerdict.desc: Whether an organ/output conforms + groundedness (self_metric shape).

ApparatusSource.desc: A pointer to something the fresh apparatus should scan for useful specs/features — the OLD apparatus or any source.

RawArtefacts.desc: Raw scanned content from a source, before it is decomposed into discrete features.

CandidateFeatures.desc: Discrete specs/features decomposed out of the raw scan — the candidates to judge.

JudgedFeatures.desc: Candidates after judgment — the useful ranked, the useless rejected (reject is first-class).

ProvenancedArtefact.desc: Any spec/feature the scan-and-select takes from the OLD apparatus, wrapped with its origin + succession status so the new machine knows it as inherited, never native. Retain history, know it as such — succession baked in, the antidote to old-artefacts-polluting-new. See FRESH_APPARATUS.md.

Bool.desc: PROPOSED foundational scalar: a JSON boolean. The vocabulary pins rich domain types but no primitives, so flat-scalar-output organs (the majority) cannot declare their output ports at all. Primitives are the most reusable studs of all. Used here for `saturated`.

Int.desc: PROPOSED foundational scalar: a JSON integer (a count). Distinct from Number to keep counts (e.g. sample_size) honest vs. continuous measures. Used here for `sample_size`.

Number.desc: PROPOSED foundational scalar: a JSON number (int or float) — a continuous measure. Used here for the seconds/hours measures (p90_seconds, max_seconds, threshold_seconds, window_hours).

Str.desc: PROPOSED foundational scalar: a JSON string (may be null where the organ contract allows). Used here for `reason_skipped` and `recommendation`.

Timestamp.desc: PROPOSED reusable scalar: an ISO-8601 datetime string (may be null). Semantically distinct from Str — it is a clock value, the standard reference-clock wire (many organs take `state.now`). Used here for the `now` input and the `checked_at` output.

CIRunList.desc: PROPOSED domain type: a list of recent CI workflow runs with the two timestamps the queue-wait analysis needs (when the run was queued vs. when a runner picked it up). The swap unit for any organ that judges CI runner saturation from run history.
